## ✨ About This Project (Meri Mehnat AurVision)

**As-salamu alaykum wa Rahmatullahi wa Barakatuh!**

**Ayaan Islamic Studio** koi aam template ya auto-generated project nahi hai — yeh app maine (**Ayaan**) apni din-raat ki mehnat, lagan, aur shauq se khud design aur engineer ki hai. Ek-ek screen, ek-ek feature, aur har ek line of code ke peeche ghanton ki mehnat shamil hai taake Musalmanon ko ek hi jagah par mukammal, khubsurat, aur modern **Islamic Super App** mil sake.

Mera maqsad tha ke ek aisi app banayi jaye jo dekhne mein **Ultra-Luxury (Pearl White, Royal Emerald & Platinum Gold)** ho aur istemal karne mein bilkul asaan, tezz, aur 100% reliable ho.

---

## 🌟 Key Features Built by Ayaan

### 📖 1. Complete Noble Quran (30 Paras / 114 Surahs)
- **Full 30 Paras (Juz) & 114 Surahs:** Mukammal Quran Majeed Uthmani Arabic script ke sath.
- **Urdu & English Translations:** Fateh Muhammad Jalandhry (اردو ترجمہ) aur Sahih International (English) सही Islami Mushaf tarteeb (RTL/LTR) ke sath.
- **Multi-Qari Audio Streaming & Offline Download:** Sheikh Mishary Rashid Alafasy, Abdul Basit, Maher Al-Muaiqly, Saad Al-Ghamdi, aur Al-Minshawi ki tilawat background player aur Ayah-by-Ayah sync ke sath.
- **Color-Coded Tajweed & Tafsir:** Har Ayah ki Tafsir aur Word-by-Word breakdown.

### 🕰️ 2. High-Precision Namaz Timings & Unkillable Adhan Alarms
- **Accurate Solar & API Timings:** Sahiwal aur duniya bhar ke cities ke liye exact Hanafi / Karachi University prayer timings, live countdown ring, aur 45-minute Jamaat grace window.
- **3-Stage Smart Alarm Engine:**
  1. **15-Min Pre-Reminder:** Wudu aur Sunnah ki tayyari ke liye gentle alert.
  2. **5-Min Audio Alert:** Jamaat se pehle Ayatul Kursi aur Durood ki tilawat.
  3. **Exact Time Full-Screen Adhan:** Lockscreen wakeup aur 7-minute exact snooze ke sath.
- **Smart Auto-Silent Mode:** Namaz ke waqt aur Masjid ke andar phone ko khud-bakhud silent karne ka nizam.

### 🎙️ 3. 30-Juz AI Hifz Studio & Live Tajweed Tutor
- Apni tilawat record karein aur real-time voice detection ke zariye apni Hifz aur Tajweed ki ghaltiyan check karein.

### 🧭 4. Pure 3D AR Qibla Viewfinder
- Live Camera AR ke zariye zameen par 3D Yellow Guide Lines aur Khana Kaaba ki exact سمت aur fasla dekhein.

### 🤲 5. Enterprise Islamic Suite
- **Smart Tahajjud Wakeup:** Raat ke aakhri hissay (Last Third of the Night) ka hisab aur circadian sleep alarm.
- **Qaza Namaz Tracker:** Chhooti hui namazon ka mukammal hisab aur progress wheel.
- **Smart Zakat Engine & Official PDF Certificate:** Gold/Silver Nisab calculation aur ek click par A4 PDF Zakat Certificate download.
- **Global Ummah Dua Wall:** Real-time community Dua feed haptic Ameen counter ke sath.
- **Halal E-Code & Barcode Scanner:** Khane peene ki cheezon ke E-Codes aur barcodes scan kar ke Halal/Haram check karein.
- **Arabic Calligraphy OCR & Tabeer (Dream Interpreter):** Imam Ibn Sirin ke usoolon ke mutabiq khwabon ki tabeer aur Arabic image translation.
- **Islamic Kids Cinema & Habit Tracker:** Bachon ke liye Anbiya (AS) ke qissay, quizzes, aur rozana ki ibadat ka XP tracker.
